fact: On 4-5 June 2025 the ANCB digital commission met in Grand-Popo to analyse the current state of communal revenue recovery and draft recommendations for digitalising it, indicating no national digital system for communes' own revenue was yet reported as deployed.
title: Première session 2025 de la commission Numérique et Innovation Technologique de l'ANCB
publisher: Association Nationale des Communes du Bénin
